stories.story_fr: Sainsbury's se differencie par la qualite de ses produits frais, dont les ventes progressent de 8% au T3 2025/26, avec Taste the Difference, marque premium a la plus forte croissance du marche (+15% sur le frais).
stories.story_en: Sainsbury's differentiates through fresh food quality, with sales up 8% in Q3 2025/26, led by Taste the Difference, the fastest-growing premium own-label brand (+15% on fresh).
stories.quote: Fresh food sales increased 8 per cent during the quarter ... Taste the Difference Fresh food sales grew 15 per cent

stories.story_fr: Les ventes d'epicerie en ligne progressent de 14% au T3 2025/26, avec une contribution significative de la livraison OnDemand, illustrant le succes du virage digital de Sainsbury's.
stories.story_en: Groceries Online sales grow 14% in Q3 2025/26, with a significant contribution from OnDemand delivery, illustrating Sainsbury's successful digital pivot.
stories.quote: Groceries Online sales increased 14 per cent over the quarter, with a significant contribution from OnDemand sales growth
